build_alpha_zero_model: build an AlphaZero model for a specified game using Flax linen or nnx API with configurable width, depth, and learning rate
visualise_model_graph: visualise the AlphaZero model graph using treescope by running the export script with the visualise flag
save_model_checkpoint: save the AlphaZero model graph as a checkpoint at step 0 by running the export script without the visualise flag
load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained AlphaZero model from a checkpoint directory and step number for further training or evaluation
configure_model_from_json: configure the AlphaZero model architecture and hyperparameters from a JSON config file instead of CLI flags
